title: Cursed Flame
description: Location: Available at the start of the game Spell: Throws a cursed fireball that deals damage on contact Works of Mercy: - Hit 20 times with this spell Blessings: - Fires a bigger fireball that slightly pushes back its target

title: Holy Cross
description: Required: Defeat [The Fallen](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=959152) Spell: Throws a corrupted cross that deals damage to enemies it hits. Returns to Rose after traveling a certain distance or hitting a wall Works of Mercy: - Find 3 different whip-type weapons - Kill 5 enemies with the same cross(not neceesseralit at the same time) - Kill 10 enemies with a whip attack Blessings: - You can throw a SECOND cross - The cross inflicts more damage the farther away it is from Rose - Catching the returning cross lets Rose regain 10% of the spell's mana cost for each time an enemy was hit, up to a maximum of 60%

title: Infernal Pyre
description: Required: Defeat [The Warrior - Joan of Arc](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=959327) Spell: Unleashes flames on the ground around Rose, igniting and launching enemies into the air Works of Mercy: - Successfully parry 15 attacks with the Holy Light - Reach a sacred place so Joan can pray - ||[Notre-Dame Painting](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=975370)|| - Set 5 enemies on fire at the same time Blessings: - Regain 25% of the spell's mana cost for each enemy hit by the central explosion, starting with the second enemy - Enemies hit by Joan's spell are thrown high in the air - Hitting an enemy with a weapon prolongs the fire on them

title: Petrifying Gaze
description: Required: Defeat [Medusa](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=960112) Spell: Petrify enemies in front of Rose Works of Mercy: - Petrify an enemy carrying a shield with Medusa's Spell - Kill 25 enemies from fall damage directly after petrifying them in the air Blessings: - Killing a petrified enemy restores a quantity of mana equivalent to Half the cost of Medusa's spell - The closer the targets affected by this spell are to Rose, the longer they remain petrified, and the more hits it takes to break the petrification

title: Blood Spikes
description: Required: Defeat [Carmilla](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=995698) Spell: Summons blood spikes to impale nearby enemies, dealing low damage and causing them to bleed. Always targets the furthest enemy on the platform Works of Mercy: - Kill 25 enemies from bleed-effect damage - Find 2 different dual blade-type weapons - Cause an enemy to bleed continuously for 10 seconds Blessings: - Applying the bleeding effect to an already bleeding enemy deals instant damage to it - Heals Rose 2% of her max health every time an enemy dies from bleeding - Bleeding enemies are slower and deal 25% less damage to Rose

title: Fist of Talos
description: Required: Defeat [The Builder - Talos](https://mapgenie.io/castlevania-belmonts-curse/maps/streets-of-paris?locationIds=1011729) Spell: A huge fist strikes the ground, dealing massive damage to enemies directly below, with much less damage to targets further away. Also triggers a small earthquake that shakes enemies in a wide radius, potentially knocking them off their platforms.
